name: cdm/event/common/ExecutionDetails
description: Defines specific attributes that relate to trade executions.

executionType.description: Identifies the type of execution, e.g. via voice, electronically...

executionVenue.description: Represents the venue on which a trade was executed.

packageReference.description: A reference to the package linking the trade with other trades, in case the trade was executed as part of a package (hence this attribute is optional).
